name: a correction after an answer that went the wrong way

source.database: local Compose install, ryker-database-1, read on 2026-09-27
source.reshaped: recorded_result is the routing model's answer byte for byte. To commit it against the seeded request, the test gives episode_ref the candidate reference of the request that answered and sets repository to null: the test route offers one repository, where the recorded route offered a choice. sentiment is the field the 2026-09-27 contract adds; no recorded answer carries one yet, so its value here is the reading the contract asks for, not a recorded one.

question.text: <@U0C1LCVNF52> In AndrewDryga/test, add a short "Workflow smoke test" section to README.md saying this repository exercises Ryker and Coop. Commit the change, push it to a branch, and open a draft PR. Leave main unchanged.

previous_answer.text:
Added the exact section to README.md and committed the README-only change on `ryker/readme-workflow-smoke-test`. Pushing failed because the Git destination couldn’t be reached, so no draft PR was created. I haven’t changed main.

Can you restore publication access for AndrewDryga/test so I can push the branch and open the draft PR against main?

message.text: The committed README change is in the isolated working copy. Do not push Git directly from the model sandbox; Ryker owns review and publication through the Coop API. Please finish the README-only checks and report the task complete so Ryker can offer and create the draft PR. No change to main.
